messages:
Claire - Partnerships: Need a regional onramp playbook for SIs that covers marketplace listings + hardware partner checks. Goal: reduce time-to-first-deploy to <48h. Who can sketch the sections?
Ibrahim - SI Programs: I'll draft the outline: prerequisites, regional compliance checklist, marketplace metadata, hardware validation matrix, lab access, and trainer runbook. ETA 3 days.
Jules - Enablement: Include a short troubleshooting matrix and a 15-min trainer demo script. Also add an appendix with common CLI commands and expected outputs.
Noah - Field Eng: For hardware partners: add a compatibility table (model sizes, quantization support, driver versions). We should require partners to validate on at least one reference image. I'll prep the ref-image build.
Tara - Marketing: Marketplace listing copy needs localized short descriptions and a clear "what's included" bullet list. Also a partner-friendly badge we can show once validated.
Claire - Partnerships: Good. Two quick constraints: gov regions require the paper KAs and dedicated private deployment signoff. Call those out early in prereqs.
Ibrahim - SI Programs: Agreed. Also planning a "fast lane" for certified SIs who pass hardware validation + marketplace listing review: they get priority sandbox seats and co-marketing. Propose fast lane checklist.
Jules - Enablement: Fast lane checklist idea: verified deploy <45m, integration test pass, marketplace metadata approved. Also we should provide a 10-question practice quiz for partners.
Noah - Field Eng: Ops notes: I'll spin up one eu-west and one us-east validation tenant. Need partner hardware firmware versions and an SSH contact for kiosk tests.
onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Publish SI regional onramp outline" in 72h (3417726400).
Tara - Marketing: I'll draft marketplace templates and the badge visuals. Request: what exact metric unlocks the badge? (deploy time threshold or test pass?)
Claire - Partnerships: Badge unlock rules: E2E deploy success + hardware validation pass OR 85% on the practice quiz. We'll document both paths.
Ibrahim - SI Programs: Action owners recap: Ibra=playbook outline + fast lane checklist, Jules=trainer script + quiz, Noah=ref-image + validation tenants, Tara=marketplace copy + badge assets, Claire=partner comms + gov signoff path. Aim to ship draft by EOD in 3 days.
Jules - Enablement: I'll also add a short "what to expect on day 1" checklist for SIs so they know emails, credentials, and support routing.
Noah - Field Eng: I'll include smoke test results schema and pass/fail examples for the playbook.
Claire - Partnerships: Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker, flag here. We'll convert the draft into a shared drive doc and link it back. :rocket:
